[[File:Ron Howe (community card).jpg|thumb|right|220px|Ron Howe, from the community card ''Ron H''.]]
'''Ron Howe''' (forums handle '''ronhowe''') is a volunteer of the [[Players Committee]]. The Players Committee organization chart of 6 May 2024 lists Ron Howe as Holotable CDF Maintainer in the infrastructure and apps group, under the [[Rules Advocate]] [[Greg Zinn]].<ref name="chart">PC Organization Chart, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback Machine capture of 10 October 2026] of [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (PDF creation date 6 May 2024).</ref> See [[Players Committee organization]].
